response.justification: While Bogdan demonstrates strong technical fundamentals and 20 years of engineering experience with proven scale credentials (Dunnhumby's millions of requests/second, Optilyz's high-volume transaction processing), he lacks the critical domain expertise required for this Principal role. The position requires deep, hands-on experience with experimentation platforms, A/B testing frameworks, feature flagging systems, and telemetry infrastructure—none of which are evident in his resume. At a Principal/IC6 level in a specialized growth/experimentation domain, this expertise gap is too significant to overcome through general technical capability.
strengths: 20+ years of progressive technical experience with demonstrated ability to ship products across web, mobile, desktop, and embedded systems at scale
Proven production-scale experience handling millions of concurrent requests at Dunnhumby and high-volume transaction processing at Optilyz
Versatile technical depth across required languages (JavaScript, TypeScript, C, C++, Java) and full-stack capability from backend infrastructure to frontend systems
concerns: No demonstrated experience building or maintaining experimentation platforms, A/B testing frameworks, or feature flagging systems—core to this role's focus
Lacks evidence of telemetry infrastructure, metrics systems, statistical analysis, or experimentation quality expertise central to growth measurement

Career progression shows breadth across diverse technologies rather than deep specialization in growth/experimentation systems; unclear if prepared for Principal-level architectural decisions in this domain
